keyVerseDR: "Fear not: from henceforth thou shalt catch men." (Lk 5:10)

level1.title: So Many Fish!
level1.story: Peter fished all night and caught nothing. Jesus said, "Put your nets out deep." They caught so many fish the nets were breaking! Peter left everything to follow Jesus.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, I will follow You. Amen.

activity.intro: Finish the picture: fill the net with fish!
activity.prompt: Peter's boat with a net bursting with fish on the Sea of Galilee

level2.title: Put Out Into Deep Water
level2.story: Jesus taught the crowds from Simon Peter's boat by the lake of Gennesaret. Then He said to Simon, "Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught." Simon said, "Master, we have labored all the night, and have taken nothing: but at Thy word I will let down the net." They caught so many fish that their nets were breaking, and two boats were filled. Peter fell at Jesus' knees, and Jesus said, "Fear not: from henceforth thou shalt catch men."
level2.keyLine: Fear not: from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What 'deep water' is Jesus asking you to try?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I will put out into the deep for You. Amen.
